notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: [p][b]COOP[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bugs in the loadout system have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed audio problems between Client Host[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed zombie sounds not coming to client[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed client minimap inconsistency[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimization tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]DirectX 12 Gpu crash fixed[/p][/*][*][p]AI perception and pathfinding tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]New injection round added[/p][/*][*][p]To make the mission system understandable, the locations to be visited in missions have been marked as a region on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dialog when the character is approaching the location relevant to the mission[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Things to do[/b][/p][list][*][p]Issue with health, infection, thirst and hunger bars not updating on the device screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon recoil adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Sound effects to indicate the state of the character[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic music system[/p][/*][*][p]Feeling improvements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list][*][p]Fixed client not being able to select weapons in loadout system.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inconsistency in infected sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added Blaster infected type[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to the number of infected on the map[/p][/*][*][p]Size of subtitles adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]Added auxiliary elements related to the quest system

Thank you for all the feedback. We will take care to keep it up to date as we make improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes: [list][*][p][b]New Loadout System[/b]: Players can now customize their equipment before entering gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad Support (W.I.P.)[/b]: Initial implementation of controller support; full compatibility is in progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapons[/b]: Additional weapons have been added to expand combat variety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Ambience[/b]: Improved environmental audio and visual effects for better immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI System Enhancements[/b]: Enemy behavior has been refined for more dynamic and challenging encounters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest System Improvements[/b]: Quest flow and tracking have been optimized for better clarity and usability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spawn System Tweaks[/b]: Adjustments made to ensure more balanced enemy spawns.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Various reported issues have been resolved to improve overall performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing and providing feedback. Your input helps us shape the future of the game.[/p]
